units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:9">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>דילמא אגב פ׳ שביק ציבחר</he> perhaps in consequence of conciliation (by presents) he may remit some (of the imposed penalty).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:13">Y. Peah VIII, end, 21ᵇ</cite> <he>דחמא … יקבל פִּיּוּסָךְ</he> may he who sees and cannot be seen, accept thy apology (as I accept it).—Pl. <cite ref="Q01464"><he>פִּיּוּסִין</he></cite>, <he>פִּיּי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 34:3">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIV, 3</cite>.—[Y. Shek. VII, 2 Bab. ed., v. <cite ref="Q00169"><he>פִּוְוסָרוֹס</he></cite>.]
